{"kind":"hv-full-content-r7","artifact":"verdict.md","sequence":12,"total":13,"artifactSha256":"8E36FE96DF037CAB1E56DFE2ACFBE22AB5764773E1B7B5C95C894334E118C9F9","content":"- Slice 1:336, D1/D2/D5: Mandatory real artifacts assert failure, never ViceFact skip. Stable R12 blocked IDs remain pending and nonzero rather than skipped/passed.

- Slice 1:338-340, D1/D5: Mocks first, complete prerequisite corruption matrix, synthetic byte cases unchanged. R15 explicitly amends only real external AC1 inputs to 1.2/1.4; N26 adds exact propagation readback.

- Slice 1:342, D1/D2/D4/D5: Mandatory provisioning, manifest, immutable external build and bounded legacy adapter; no runtime patch and no adapter broadening.

- Slice 1:347-350, D1/D2/D5: Approved old scripts retired, validation commands replaced with canonical observer builder, GenerateNativeSnapshotFixtures and cumulative through-slice-1 target.

Structured what-if outcomes:

- Different checkpoint write clocks between hosts: One-host and both-host mismatches are BLOCKED by stable xvic case ID, nonzero cumulative exit, both contexts retained. Candidate publication is isolated; no rearm or substituted literal. F05/N14/N21 PASS.

- Trap during an already-dispatched interrupt: Copied ik may lack the newly armed trap. The handler first opcode may execute before the next sample. D1 mock and D5 context retain actual callback clock, which fails literal R12 if later. N22 PASS.

- Request inside a stolen-cycle run: Armed gate composition preserves one gate/permit per advanced cycle and withheld permits stop advancement. Actual write clock remains distinct; no forced 100000 value. N15 PASS.

- First resumed access is stolen: Retain idle/stolen prefix, first actual CPU read/dummy at PC and own BA-derived AEC from the marker. No history reuse or warm-up trimming; compare the whole W/2W window. N02/N10 PASS.

- Shim reached only through provider or attribute: Semantic inventory includes the path; audit covers discovery through exit, and deliberate attempts log/fail. N24 adds a successful ordinary-discovery case. Existing empty-log gate prevents unsafe restoration.

- Audit file missing or unwritable: Attempt/gate fails loudly, never empty-log success; positive controls have separate logs. N11/N16 PASS.

- Known-red set changes, including equal-sized substitution: A05 compares exact FQNs and complete terminal project evidence. Improvement, regression, omission, skip or partial run does not fit R9 and must be reported; no silent baseline amendment.

- Windows autocrlf: Original host bytes retain their own hashes. Already-restored state is tested by Git, not blob-byte equality. CRLF mock and wrong-host/path drift controls are explicit. A04 PASS.

- Crash/restart during preservation, restoration or candidate write: No overwrite before verified preservation; resume classifies restored/untouched/unexpected, later failure stops before E without auto-reapply. Accepted fixtures/manifest remain unchanged and stale retry output is rejected. N25 covers absent native partial file.

- Low restored clock and prelude-safe raised limit: Canonical D1 exception is measured prelude length+W; load,0 then exactly W compared cycles/2W records, bounded limit/quit outcome, permit/tail/exit receipts. Unsupplied-permit wait, early stop and stretched window are rejected. N23 PASS.

- Missing runtime/fixture, malformed module or unsupported host: D1 mock prerequisite matrix rejects every omission/corruption; D5 real artifacts are mandatory with zero skips. Only the explicit R12 xvic cases may be BLOCKED, with independent host evidence; no stale host artifact substitutes.

- Cross-workspace/session or stale evidence: D4 checks repository/host/gitlink and host-specific committed preservation. D5 uses artifacts produced in that run. This review uses its own parent-linked turn and exact scoped history query.

- R12 blocked while ordinary/cumulative gates run: Shared Test/CiTest selectors exclude ShimLegacy and VsfSlice1Real, retain contract tests, and project discovered IDs at D2/D5. Cumulative includes all required real IDs and remains nonpassing. The previous selector deadlock is removed. N20 P"}
